SPORT & SPA HOTEL ZERMATT
Find your
FLOW
We dare you to visit. To get in balance via the beats of Zermatt. Looking to relax and recharge? Come rest. Hungry for new memories and adventures? Come move. Ready to find your FLOW? Come visit.
Play the video
THE IMPORTANCE OF FLOW
FLOW is inherently restorative and pleasurable. It's that rare state of being completely absorbed in what you're doing. Things are effortless. Life is energising. Here's THE SCHLOSS METHOD to finding your FLOW...
What is FLOW? Why does it matter?
Read
FLOW is inherently restorative and pleasurable. It's that rare state of being completely absorbed in what you're doing, where things seem effortless and feel energising.
1. F ocus
Read
Distraction is the enemy. FLOW needs mindfulness not self-consciousness. No internal or external noise, just intuitive engagement. How? CBD Spa, yoga, skiing.
2. L iveliness
Read
FLOW is feeling alive with energy, clarity and zest - things that come from giving your body what it needs. How? Powerful breakfast, restorative sleep, easy-going environment.
3. O penness
Read
FLOW is being open to new moods, connections and frivolities. Getting instant positive feedback and satisfaction. How? Time at the bar, in Zermatt, playing games, tobogganing.
4. W ell-Balanced
Read
Be stretched but not overwhelmed. Prioritise your interests and push your body. With FLOW, every action is intrinsically rewarding. How? Gym, yoga, swim, outdoor challenges.
FILL UP ON LIFE
At SCHLOSS Zermatt, finding your FLOW can take you anywhere: our CBD Spa, free yoga, workouts, waffles, walking around Zermatt… Wherever you want to go, our team will help you find the way.
Wellness Weeks
01
Wellness Weeks - A slower November
From 13 to 28 November , things slow down at SCHLOSS Zermatt. The WELLNESS WEEKS are an invitation to pause before winter begins – with daily sauna rituals , ice bathing, breathwork and yoga.
Link
Rooms, Suites & Apartments
02
Created with your wellbeing in mind
Each bedroom is designed to boost physical and mental recovery, enhance mood, and deliver a restorative rest in beds from the experts at Jensen.
Link
CBD & Adaptogenic Spa
03
Downtime is essential time
Built on the power of CBD and functional mushrooms, the spa is our HQ for vital recovery with several saunas, baths, relaxation and treatment rooms.
Link
Gym & Sport
04
Arrive jadded. Leave pumped.
Move and mould in our functional area. Fire up the body via a programme of free and daily fitness classes. Go 1 on 1 with a personal training session.
Link
Yoga
05
Put your body in motion
From upbeat and dynamic, to slow and gentle flow, with everything from beginner to pro. Free yoga and pilates classes run throughout the week.
Link
Breakfast
06
Food for fuel
A BIG reason to get out of bed. Protein-rich bowls, fluffy waffles, local eggs, fresh smoothies and a vegan corner will prep you for the day ahead.
Link
Activities
07
Rewarding adventure with balance
Walk, run, jog, trek, bike and hike around the giant alfresco gym of Zermatt. Or sit by the fire, read a book, and stare out on the world. Your call.
Link
Where will
the FLOW take you?
Enter a FLOW UP state to explore, experiment, and push a bit further than before. Opt to FLOW DOWN to ease off, unwind and refresh.
Your choice
Flow up
Flow down
Bodyweight training
Go against gravity. Our free bodyweight workout classes improve strength, endurance and power - firing up muscles for the mountains.
Invigorating yoga
Rise and energise with free yoga classes that stretch and strengthen. Targeting full-body awareness, these classes will open you up to the day.
Outdoor yoga
Nature is a healer. Start your day with outdoor yoga under the Matterhorn, then go deeper with forest bathing and a walking meditation.
Restorative yoga
Let it all go. Our free yoga classes range from meditative motions to balanced breathing and focused connection. Newbie or regular? No matter.
Walking meditation & forest bathing
A total immersion in nature to relax and FLOW. Under the gaze of the Matterhorn slow down and find connection from within and around.
TRX classes
From push-ups to planks, straps are suspended from the ceiling to help you build core strength, increase lean muscle and improve mobility.
Nature dog walks
Easily accessible paths offer a gentle jaunt in nature. You can also take the cable car up the mountain, pack a picnic and enjoy the view.
Kettlebell workouts
Combining strength, mobility, body balance and mental power, this is the ultimate conditioning class for both seasoned athletes and gym newbies.
Guided nature hike & lunch
Learn about local herbs, history and nature, before relaxing by glacial lakes and taking a plunge if you dare. Lunch at a lodge awaits.
Dinners out
Foodies be warned: Zermatt’s got a lot going on. Swiss dishes, alpine cuisine, plus a new wave of fine-dining and international fare.
CBD & Adaptogenic Spa
SWITCH off the world
We breathe over 20,000 times a day. That’s 20,000 breaths you probably never think about. Time to take a proper breath? Head to our CBD Spa for moments of quiet, rest, remedy or therapy - all powered by organic CBD and vital mushrooms.

FLOW-based
wellness
The state of FLOW can lead to the best stuff in life - new inspirations, interests and intentions - but finding it is tricky. You need a place that rebalances life and pushes you in all the right ways. A place like SCHLOSS Zermatt.
The light-hearted
& fun take on life
Sport at SCHLOSS
01
Make your move
This is where the action is. In the gym, the pool, a free yoga class or a fitness workout. Or out on a hike, bike, walk or climb.
Families at SCHLOSS
02
Our guide to keeping the kids smiling
Zermatt's mountain railways, lifts, ski schools, and restaurants are made for kids and families. As is SCHLOSS Zermatt. Here you find more information about our family offer.
Dogs at SCHLOSS
03
Our guide to dog-friendly Zermatt
Dogs are more than welcome at SCHLOSS Zermatt, and we have a stack of tips and services to help you keep them happy and healthy. To the guide !
CBD & Adaptogenic Spa
04
Welcome to the moment
Our 630m² CBD & Adaptogenic Spa shuts out the noise to turn up the relaxation. Breathe, feel the water and air on your skin, let go to the moment.
Ski Room
05
Simple, safe, warm
After a bluebird day, it’s just a short walk back to us. Leave your gear in our secure ski room with its boot-drying facilities and tool workbench.
Games Room
06
Come and play
Ready for families and friends, the Games Room has table football, table tennis, darts, lego and more. Plus there’s snooker in the room next door.
Rent bikes or skis
07
The best equipment at better prices
Don’t know who to rent from? We do. Whether’s it’s a bike, board, skis or helmet, we’ll help you hire the best and get a discount.
Bike Room
08
Store, clean, service
Park up in our Bike Room and make full use of our cleaning and service station. Need to hire any kit? We’ll help you hire the best and get a discount.
Our values: what to expect from us
01 - Easy-going
Come, go, flow. We re straightforward and uncomplicated (although not to be confused with ordinary).
Our values: what to expect from us
02 - FAMILY-FIRST
We re family, literally, here to look after you and look out for you. If you re happy then we re happy.
Our values: what to expect from us
03 - DYNAMIC
We like to stay on our toes and always look ahead, hungry to do more and push for better.
Our values: what to expect from us
04 - DARING
We challenge ourselves, and you, to stay in FLOW. We know when to push and pull.
Our values: what to expect from us
05 - FUN
We re all here for a good time, not a long time, and SCHLOSS Zermatt is about the best of times. Joy, contentment, and squeezing the most out of life.
Our values: what to expect from us
06 - BALANCED
Everything is about balance. Coffee in the morning, cocktails in the evening. No judgement or expectations about what you should be doing.
Why SCHLOSS Zermatt?
In the heart of Zermatt
SCHLOSS Zermatt is tucked away on a quiet side street - 120 seconds from Zermatt’s train station, coffee shops, ski shops and lux boutiques.
Central location
Your active holiday
CBD & Adaptogenic Spa
Family-run
Life in full colour
Get up, get out, get moving
Recharge batteries, rearrange cells, activate joy. SCHLOSS Zermatt champions adventure with balance. Wherever you go, and however you move, have fun.
Central location
Your active holiday
CBD & Adaptogenic Spa
Family-run
Life in full colour
Feel good, naturally
CBD, adaptogens and vital mushrooms are considered to be nature’s way of relaxing body and mind . Let them work their magic via a treatment, therapy, or time in the spa.
Central location
Your active holiday

Here since 1984
We, the Perren family, have been looking after the hotel and guests since 1984. That makes everything more personal. Your euphoria is in our hands.
Central location
Your active holiday

Family-run

Fill up on The Good Life
Think, do, feel, be. We’re about living for the moment and finding the right balance. Ready to get the good times flowing? Come see us.

Welcome
to the family
We, the Perren family, have been looking after SCHLOSS Zermatt for nearly 40 years. In that time we’ve renovated, redesigned and evolved, but one thing has remained constant: our passion for taking care of people (both our clients and staff). Our familial atmosphere is one of the reasons why staff stay with us for a long time, and why guests return each year for more fun. .
Meet the team
Alex Perren (Man of the house)
Read
"Fast descents are just what I need every now and then to clear my head. With the north face of the Matterhorn behind me - and an unobstructed view of the Weisshorn, the Mischabel group, and the upper Mattertal - this ride is always a highlight. Be sure to plan a stop at Stafelalp."
Julia (Deputy Managerin)
Read
"To me, SCHLOSS Zermatt is all about lightness and genuine, easygoing warmth. There are no rigid rules here – everyone is free to simply be themselves. No one has to fit a mold. That's exactly what makes this a place where you feel truly at home – whether as a guest or as part of our team.”
Marcela (Massage Therapist)
Read

Sleep well
live well
Stylish, cosy and fresh, our bedrooms are built to provide the best rest possible with Super King Jensen beds and special kits for sports and sleep.
View the gallery
The bedrock
of FLOW
Sleep is vital for strong physical and mental health, and is the foundation for getting in a state of FLOW. Rest brings an alertness, freshness and focus, giving us the energy to fully engage with what we’re doing and who we’re with.
At SCHLOSS Zermatt, sleep is about quantity and quality. Central but quiet, bedrooms range in size from Solo to Suite. For larger groups there’s also the Apartment, Penthouse or Cottage which come with home comforts like kitchen and laundry facilities.

We now have special sleep and sports kits in every room, suite and apartment. The aim of both is to create the right conditions to get you in your FLOW. Conditions that remove life’s stressors and distractions, and that challenge you in just the right way. Not too much and not too little.

You got questions.
We got answers.
BOOKING
Where and how do we get the best price?
01
Book directly with us. You get the best price when you book via our website . Generally, the earlier you book and the longer you stay, the better the price.
What does direct booking advantage mean?
02
When booking via our homepage, telephone or email you review a direct booker discount up to 20% and a welcome gift.
Why is the same room sometimes more/less?
03
Our prices and availability depend on the date of your booking, general demand, and the occupancy of the hotel during your desired dates.
Is it possible to request a specific room?
04
Yes, but we can’t guarantee that we’ll be able to accommodate. We’ll certainly do our best.
Can we bring our dog?
05
100%. CHF 20 is charged per day. We’re happy to provide food and water bowls, and a dog basket in your room.
Can I add a birthday/romantic surprise?
06
Yes - just let us know. We can prepare a small surprise in your room for no extra charge.
What services are included in the price?
07
Full use of the spa and fitness facilities, including free yoga. Daily breakfast. Coffee and tea corner in the afternoon from 3-5pm. And VAT.
Can I book without a credit card?
08
No. A credit card number is mandatory, with a prepayment of your total stay taken in line with our cancellation policy.
Should I take out travel insurance?
09
Yes - it is strongly recommended. Free-of-charge cancellations outside of the cancellation period are no longer possible.
ARRIVAL / CHECK-IN
What time is check-in?
01
We guarantee check-in from 3pm. If your room is ready earlier, you can of course check in earlier. In any case, you can leave luggage with us and make use of our changing rooms.
How do you travel to car-free Zermatt?
02
The train goes directly to Zermatt (which is a car-free zone). If travelling by car, the journey ends in Täsch which is 5km from Zermatt. You then continue by shuttle train or taxi to the resort at the foot of the Matterhorn. Head here for more info: www.zermatt.ch/en/arrival .
Where can I park? Do I need to reserve?
03
The Matterhorn Terminal in Täsch offers 2,100 covered parking spaces. There are also over 1,000 parking spaces with private providers such as taxi companies and hotels. Head here for more info on parking spaces in Täsch. You can check the timetable for the Täsch-Zermatt shuttle train service right here .
I m arriving late. Will the hotel be open?
04
Yes. Our front desk is open from 6am to 11pm. After 11pm, our night manager will welcome you.
Do you offer a pick-up service?
05
SCHLOSS Zermatt is 50 metres from Zermatt’s train station. You can walk to it in 2 minutes or, upon request, we can pick you and your luggage up, for free, from the station or taxi drop-off with our electric car.
Which airport is the closest one to Zermatt?
06
Geneva and Zürich are the closest airports, about 3.5 hours away from Zermatt. Milan Malpensa is also about 3 hours away, but onward travel is only possible by car or taxi as there is no suitable train connection.
Departure / Check-Out
What time is check-out?
01
11am.
Is it possible to have a late check-out?
02
Assuming your room is not booked by anyone else, we can organise a late check-out for 12h at no extra charge. Just speak to our front desk.
Can I use the spa on my day of departure?
03
Absolutely. And at no extra charge.
What payment methods do you accept?
04
Mastercard, Visa, American Express, TWINT and cash.
General Hotel Info
Where exactly is the hotel located?
01
SCHLOSS Zermatt has a prime location just off the village centre. You can reach all the best spots quickly and easily, either by foot or electric car. For example:
1 minute to the next bus stop (direction Matterhorn Glacier Paradise)
2 minutes to the railway station
2 minutes to the Gornergrat station
5 minutes to the nearest bike and ski rental stores
7 minutes to the Sunnegga-Rothorn station
2-15 minutes to Zermatt’s various shops and restaurants
Can I drink the tap water?
02
100%. Zermatt's tap water consists of 100% pure spring water.
How big is SCHLOSS Zermatt?
03
SCHLOSS Zermatt has 56 rooms, suites and apartments across three buildings: the main house, an extension built in 2020, and a cottage just a minute walk from the hotel.
Where is the Cottage located?
04
Converted from former hay barns in 2019/20, the Cottage is a minute walk from the main building. Ideal for a family, group of friends or colleagues, you get full access to the hotel’s services and facilities as well as a bunch of extras like a mini-cinema and private sauna.
As you re close to town, are rooms quiet?
05
Yes. Despite its central location, SCHLOSS Zermatt is not affected by traffic-related noise as rooms are tucked away and have triple-glazed sound-proofed windows. Even the nearby Gornergrat railway is not usually heard.
Which rooms have a view of the Matterhorn?
06
Each room, suite or apartment with ‘View’ in its name offers a guaranteed view of the Matterhorn.
Is there air conditioning in the rooms?
07
Thanks to the fresh mountain climate, there’s no need! That said, of course we do have heating in the rooms.
Are the apartments also in the main building?
08
Yes - apartments are in the main house.
Are extra beds or baby cots provided?
09
Cots are available in all rooms, and sofa-beds can be added in most (check a room/suite’
